scientific_integrity: Analytical universal identity checked by direct matrix algebra and supplementary rational and matrix-series numerical calculations; independent scientific audit and field validation not performed. Published mathematical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: An idealized source-free two-compartment, first-order, deterministic riverbed-storage model, restricted to two prescribed regime-duration pairs and terminal cumulative export. Rate triples are not empirically calibrated; no conclusions for multi-stage optimization or spatial river transport.
title: A duration-independent order law for reversible riverbed contaminant storage
